svg.title: Isochrones on foot and by bicycle from the Alto da Sé, Olinda, without and with elevation
svg.desc: Four maps of Olinda and the north of Recife. On the left, the areas reached from the Alto da Sé, on the hill of the historic centre, within 10, 20 and 30 minutes walking and cycling on flat ground; on the right, the same with the slopes, with the flat 30-minute outline dashed.

g.text: Areas reached in 10, 20 and 30 minutes on foot and by bicycle. Right: with Tobler's slope costs
(Copernicus DEM GLO-90); dashed: the flat 30-minute isochrone
From the Alto da Sé, Olinda: flat and with slopes
